title: 更好的答案，更广阔的思维：学生从ChatGPT与批判性思维训练中获得的收益
summary: OpenAI发布了一项针对超过1000名大学生的随机对照研究，旨在评估ChatGPT与批判性思维训练对学生完成真实大学作业表现的影响。研究将学生分为不同组别，部分使用ChatGPT，部分接受批判性思维训练，部分两者结合。结果显示，结合使用ChatGPT和批判性思维训练的学生在作业原创性、答案质量和思维广度上显著优于其他组别。ChatGPT提供了更全面的信息参考，而批判性思维训练帮助学生更好地评估、筛选和整合信息，从而提升整体学术表现。研究强调，AI工具并非替代思考，而是辅助思考的催化剂，关键在于培养学生的批判性思维能力，以充分利用AI的潜力。该研究为教育领域如何整合AI工具提供了实证依据，并提出了在教学中融入AI素养和批判性思维训练的必要性。
summary_en: OpenAI released a randomized controlled study involving over 1,000 university students to examine the effects of ChatGPT and critical thinking training on student performance in a real-world university assignment. Students were divided into groups using ChatGPT, receiving critical thinking training, or both. Results showed that the combination of ChatGPT and critical thinking training significantly outperformed other groups in originality, answer quality, and breadth of thinking. ChatGPT provided comprehensive information, while critical thinking training helped students evaluate, filter, and integrate information effectively. The study emphasizes that AI tools are not substitutes for thinking but catalysts, highlighting the need to cultivate critical thinking skills to leverage AI's potential. This research provides empirical evidence for integrating AI tools in education and underscores the importance of AI literacy and critical thinking training.
